name: electron-window-corner-addon
description: Native macOS window corner radius addon for Electron
author: Innei

scripts.build:native: node -e "if (process.platform === 'darwin') { require('child_process').execSync('npm run build:swift && node-gyp rebuild', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { console.log('Skipping native build on non-macOS platform'); }"
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:native
scripts.build:debug: node -e "if (process.platform === 'darwin') { require('child_process').execSync('npm run build:swift && node-gyp rebuild --debug', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { console.log('Skipping debug build on non-macOS platform'); }"
scripts.clean: node -e "if (process.platform === 'darwin') { require('child_process').execSync('node-gyp clean && cd swift && swift package clean', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }" && rm -rf dist
